confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors agree closely across cost-of-living index listings surfaced in search (Numbeo, Expatistan, Livingcost, Citycost), so they are the firmest. Cocktail and wine rest on sparse single-venue prices and beer ratios (cocktail about 4.5x and wine about 3.4x the beer anchor). Local-currency prices were converted at about 2,600 TZS per USD, within the 2,500-2,700 range the sources imply but not checked against a live quote. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live booking pages or current listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors come from Arusha-specific cost-of-living listings; accommodation is a holistic estimate for Arusha as a mid-sized safari hub with hostels and mid-range hotels.
